title: PCP keystone (v1)
description: A single curated, user-affirmed claim about the person, with provenance for trust-weighting.

status.description: Record lifecycle ONLY -- not approval. Only user-affirmed keystones appear on the portable surface.

generated_by.description: Actor who authored the record: 'human:<id>', '<producer>/<version>', or 'process:<id>'. See spec 3.2.1.

last_confirmed_by.description: Actor who last affirmed the claim, same forms as generated_by. A 'human:' actor outranks an agent or process; readers derive the tier and MUST NOT discard unattributed keystones. See spec 3.2.1.

stale_after.description: Absolute date (YYYY-MM-DD) on or after which the claim should be treated as stale. Advisory, not lifecycle -- a stale keystone is still served, labeled. See spec 3.2.2.

supersedes.description: id of a keystone this one replaces

extensions.description: Namespaced custom fields. Readers MUST preserve unknown keys.
